Calculate Modified Soil Adjusted Vegetation Index 2 (MSAVI)

Source: R/calc_indices.R
calc_msavi.Rd

Computes the Modified Soil Adjusted Vegetation Index 2 (MSAVI2), which eliminates the need for manually finding or specifying a soil adjustment factor L.

Usage

calc_msavi(nir, red)

Arguments

nir

Near-infrared band (terra::SpatRaster or numeric).

red

Red band (terra::SpatRaster or numeric).

Value

A terra::SpatRaster (named "MSAVI") or numeric vector with index values.

Details

$$MSAVI = \frac{2 \times NIR + 1 - \sqrt{(2 \times NIR + 1)^2 - 8 \times (NIR - RED)}}{2}$$

Description & Purpose: MSAVI simplifies SAVI by calculating an inductive soil adjustment factor mathematically, providing high sensitivity in sparse vegetation without requiring empirical soil line parameters.

References

Qi, J., Chehbouni, A., Huete, A. R., Kerr, Y. H., & Sorooshian, S. (1994). A modified soil adjusted vegetation index. Remote Sensing of Environment, 48(2), 119-126.

See also

calc_savi, calc_osavi, geo_index

Examples

# Numeric scalar calculation
calc_msavi(nir = 0.7, red = 0.2)
#> [1] 0.536675

# Raster layer calculation
img <- get_example_data()
msavi_rast <- calc_msavi(nir = img[["nir"]], red = img[["red"]])
print(msavi_rast)
#> class       : SpatRaster
#> size        : 10, 10, 1  (nrow, ncol, nlyr)
#> resolution  : 10, 10  (x, y)
#> extent      : 440000, 440100, 5410000, 5410100  (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax)
#> coord. ref. : WGS 84 / UTM zone 31N (EPSG:32631)
#> source(s)   : memory
#> name        :     MSAVI
#> min value   : -0.091755
#> max value   :  0.914637
